video_summary.overall_goal: Create a new folder named 'test' in the Alarms directory and navigate into it
video_summary.description: User navigates through Amaze file manager, opens Alarms folder, creates a new folder named 'test', and navigates into it. The app crashes while inside the test folder.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Android app drawer showing various installed apps including Amaze file manager
steps.visual_feedback: App drawer visible, all icons displayed in grid

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Amaze file manager opened showing /storage/emulated/0 with 11 folders and 0 files
steps.visual_feedback: Alarms folder highlighted, list of folders displayed

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Alarms folder opened, showing empty directory with 'No Files' message
steps.visual_feedback: Context menu slides up from bottom showing Folder, File, Cloud Connection options
steps.intent_task: Access context menu to create new folder

steps.what_screen_is_visible: New Folder dialog box appeared with text input field and keyboard
steps.system_response: New Folder dialog opened with keyboard
steps.visual_feedback: Dialog box centered on screen with input field ready for text entry, keyboard visible at bottom

steps.what_screen_is_visible: New Folder dialog with 'test' partially typed in input field
steps.visual_feedback: Characters appear in input field as user types, cursor visible, text suggestions update

steps.what_screen_is_visible: New Folder dialog with complete 'test' text in input field
steps.visual_feedback: CREATE button ready to tap, highlighted in pink
steps.intent_task: Confirm folder creation by tapping CREATE

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Dialog closed, Alarms folder view shows 'test' folder in the list with 'Creating Folder' status message
visible_ui_elements: Alarms directory path showing 1 folder count
steps.system_response: Folder 'test' created and added to file list
steps.visual_feedback: Toast message 'Creating Folder' shown, then test folder appears in list with folder icon
steps.intent_task: Wait for folder creation to complete

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Alarms folder view showing the newly created 'test' folder in the list
steps.visual_feedback: test folder highlighted, list shows folder selected
steps.intent_task: Open the newly created test folder

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Navigated into test folder at /storage/emulated/0/Alarms/test, empty folder with 'No Files' message
steps.visual_feedback: Empty folder view with standard no files message
steps.intent_task: Confirm successful navigation into test folder

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Error dialog appearing showing 'Amaze has stopped' with options to 'Open app again' or 'Mute until device restarts'
steps.visual_feedback: Error dialog overlaid on app drawer, clear crash notification
steps.intent_task: System indicates application crash while in test folder

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Crash dialog dismissed, app drawer returned to normal view, then app reopened to Alarms/test folder location
steps.visual_feedback: App drawer clears, Amaze reopens, navigates back to test folder location

overall_flow: Open Amaze file manager from app drawer
Long-press in empty area to open context menu
Select Folder option from context menu
Tap CREATE to confirm folder creation
Wait for folder creation to complete
Tap test folder to navigate into it
App crashes with 'Amaze has stopped' error
human_readable_step_summary: User opens Amaze file manager by tapping its icon in the app drawer
File manager displays /storage/emulated/0 with multiple folders including Alarms
User taps Alarms folder to navigate into it
Alarms folder opens showing empty directory
User long-presses in the empty area to trigger context menu
Context menu appears with options for Folder, File, and Cloud Connection
User taps Folder to open the New Folder dialog
New Folder dialog appears with text input field and on-screen keyboard
User types 'test' character by character into the input field
User taps CREATE button to confirm folder creation
System creates the test folder and displays 'Creating Folder' toast message
test folder appears in the Alarms directory list
User taps test folder to navigate into it
User successfully enters the test folder showing empty directory
App crashes with 'Amaze has stopped' error dialog
User sees error dialog with options to reopen app or mute notifications
App dialog is dismissed or system automatically recovers
Amaze file manager is relaunched and returns to test folder location
